clues: This is the largest resort city in Russia, on the Black Sea. It rests in the south of the land, by the Caucasus hills.
Palm trees grow here, yet cold north winds chill each winter. The air drops below freezing each year in this warm sea town.
In 2018, this city was one of the host towns for the World Cup. Fans from all lands came here for the big games.
This city runs on and on along the coast for 145 kilometres. It is thought to be the longest city in all of Europe.
This town held the Winter Games in 2014. Ski races ran at a resort in the hills not far from its streets.
